notice: Synthetic dataset. These are findings about generated data, not real-world parking statistics.
insights: Weekday bookings peak at 18:00 (12.53 per day) against about 5.3 per hour at midday; weekends have no morning peak.
Friday is the busiest day (128.1 bookings per day) and Sunday the quietest (94.7).
Monthly bookings grew from 2,938 in Oct 25 to 4,294 in Sep 26.
Zone C has the most bookings (10,636) and Zone H the fewest (1,635); Zone A earns the most completed revenue.
Average occupancy rises with demand: 32.7% at Low, 59.1% at Medium and 73.2% at High.
Owners charge 0.954x, 1.037x and 1.156x their base price at Low, Medium and High demand.
Cancellations rise with distance: 7.6% within 0.5 km against 27.6% at 3-5 km.
Listings priced above similar listings in their zone get fewer bookings (Spearman -0.238).
